name: Belgian Witbier-II
description: Second iteration of Belgian Witbier with enhanced citrus and coriander notes.

name: Grapefruit Citra IPA
description: Grapefruit peel infused IPA heavily dry-hopped with Citra.

name: Midnight Wit
description: Dark wheat beer brewed with Belgian yeast and roasted dehusked malt.

name: Cheri-Citron Wit
description: Belgian style wheat ale with sweet cherry and lemon zest additions.

name: Belgian Witbier
description: Classic Belgian wit with coriander seeds and bitter orange peel.

name: German Red Ale (Altbier)
description: An Altbier fermented at ale temperatures and bottle-conditioned at lager temperatures. A delicious caramelly red ale powered by Munich malt.

name: Dubbel Trouble
description: Trappist-style Belgian Dubbel brewed with homemade Belgian Dark Candi syrup. Copper red color, aromatic with dark caramel, raisins, and dried plum flavors.
award: Scored 33.5/50 at Amber Waves of Grains 2017

name: Double Chocolate Milk Stout
description: Rich sweet stout brewed with two kinds of baker's chocolate in the boil and cacao nibs in the secondary. Intense aroma with coffee notes and a vanilla finish.

name: Spiced Winter Saison
description: Dark amber to red Saison brewed with Belgian biscuit malt and dehusked black malt. Toasty aroma with spicy, peppery yeast character that evolves with age.

name: Blueberry Wheat
description: Deep pink American fruit wheat beer crafted with blueberries split between boil and secondary for vibrant fruit aroma and wine-like tartness.

name: Russian Imperial Stout (KBS Clone)
description: Imperial Stout infused with dark roast coffee, bittersweet chocolate, and aged with bourbon-soaked medium toast oak cubes.

name: Nutty Brown Ale
description: English-style brown ale brewed with biscuit malt and subtle chocolate additions. Smooth, nutty, and exceptionally drinkable.

name: Belgian Pumpkin Ale
description: Autumn ale combining Belgian yeast esters with pumpkin spices and rich biscuit malt character.

name: Vanilla Latte Stout
description: Silky milk stout infused with dark roast cold-brew coffee and whole Madagascar vanilla beans.

name: Centennial / Cascade IPA
description: Classic Pacific Northwest double-C IPA generously dry-hopped with Centennial and Cascade for floral pine and grapefruit aroma.

name: Honey Ginger Ale
description: Refreshing summer ale brewed with freshly crushed ginger root, Canadian honey malt, and raw wildflower honey.

name: Honey Orange Wheat Ale
description: Summer wheat beer infused with sweet orange peel, fresh orange zest, and steeped honey malt.

name: Black Coffee Wheat
description: Dunkelweizen brewed with German wheat and Carafa Special dehusked roasted malt delivering natural roasted coffee undertones.

name: Bourbon Barrel Porter
description: Robust imperial porter aged on Kentucky bourbon-soaked American oak cubes with subtle pure vanilla bean notes.

name: Orange Hefeweizen
description: Traditional Bavarian Hefeweizen spiced with sweet citrus peels in late boil, accentuating banana and clove yeast esters.

name: Rum Runner Stout
description: Heavy-bodied, high-gravity stout conditioned with Captain Morgan spiced rum in the secondary.

name: Chinook IPA
description: The inaugural 1-gallon batch that started the homebrew journey! Heavy pine, resinous hop character from 100% Chinook hops.
